cluster_summary: Multiple CVEs in this cluster involve parsing user-controlled structured data (YAML, JSON, binary) without enforcing a maximum nesting depth or recursion limit, allowing attackers to craft deeply nested inputs that cause stack overflow or resource exhaustion. The vulnerabilities span different parsers and data formats but share a common root of missing depth checks.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Add a depth counter incremented before each collection and decremented after, throwing an exception if the depth exceeds a configurable limit..
